empirical_proposition: all admitted views capable of the same assertion slot agree within frozen tolerance
preconditions: same lawful input; same claim; valid views; adequate support
deterministic_component: normalize outputs and compare to tolerance
default_action: retain weaker common claim; stronger views optional

empirical_proposition: material difference is predicted by a preregistered view loss
preconditions: valid common input/claim; known loss maps to disagreement component
deterministic_component: match loss registry to affected invariant
semantic_adjudication: whether lost invariant is constitutive of claim
defeated_by: loss fails to explain sign/magnitude or affected invariant was required
default_action: report loss; narrow claim or invalidate lossy view for stronger claim

empirical_proposition: otherwise lawful representations give materially different answers to same assertion slot beyond tolerance
preconditions: same input; same claim/invariant; both valid; adequate support
defeated_by: one view invalid; claim mismatch; known loss fully explains difference
default_action: retain representation dependence; run weaker-object court

empirical_proposition: result changes across lawful nuisance specifications inside one representation family
preconditions: one view family; frozen claim permits variants
semantic_adjudication: which variants are genuinely lawful for claim
defeated_by: variant changes claim/estimand or instability disappears under preregistered range
default_action: narrow or weaken view claim; may remain diagnostic

empirical_proposition: apparently conflicting lawful choices instantiate different claims/invariants/scales
preconditions: comparison cannot freeze one claim identity
defeated_by: claim successfully frozen as one proposition

empirical_proposition: pattern is stable only within a predeclared locality/scale and disappears under lawful broader aggregation
preconditions: locality/scale is explicitly part of claim family
semantic_adjudication: whether scale dependence is substantive target or nuisance
defeated_by: local result unstable even within its scope
default_action: record bounded local claim and forbid global promotion

empirical_proposition: result changes with conditioning set or baseline
preconditions: conditioning alternatives lawfully correspond to distinct or nested claims
semantic_adjudication: whether conditioning set is constitutive of claim
defeated_by: change caused by invalid support/leakage rather than conditioning
default_action: split/nest claims; if one frozen claim still varies, mark sensitivity

empirical_proposition: motif/graph/cluster assertion exists only over narrow threshold choices
preconditions: threshold family predeclared and all choices admissible
defeated_by: one threshold uniquely source-authorized or instability due coding error
default_action: weaken/abstain unless threshold is substantively governed

empirical_proposition: available support/uncertainty cannot distinguish agreement, sensitivity, or null
preconditions: valid input and claim but evidence weak
default_action: abstain; preserve exact existence if known

empirical_proposition: multiple incompatible view outputs/specifications fit evidence equally under admissible rules and no discriminative test exists
co-required claim invariants are preserved by different valid views and no tested weaker single object preserves all
preconditions: passes weaker-object court and nonredundancy test
semantic_adjudication: which invariants are co-required by claim
defeated_by: a weaker object preserves all; one invariant not actually required

empirical_proposition: minimal multi-view set is necessary within a frozen finite admissible-object universe and survives all applicable falsification
preconditions: all hard gates; closure declaration; no lawful transform/weaker object; holdout/nuisance where applicable
deterministic_component: coverage, transform, weaker-object, perturbation, holdout checks
defeated_by: new lawful weaker object or transform supersedes; one view invalid; claim splits
default_action: emit bounded status with explicit universe/scope
